duration: 12 calendar months; date must be sealed separately before activation
coverage_basis: confirmation close timestamps in [start,end), one expected H1 close per UTC hour
pre_activation_tokens: Record every unchanged model emission; primary excludes events with any token or AO vertex before actual session activation, including child sessions. Never alter emitter/cooldown.
revisions: Append original/correction bytes and field deltas with request/receipt/record timestamps; flag affected results DISPUTED; never overwrite or reselect the favorable vintage. Reviewed child session links parent tip and corrected technical prefix; cohort never resets.

funding.retry: Only on new funding coverage generation or fixed deadline; UNKNOWN terminal when incomplete. Later official corrections append amendments/disputes, never silently reopen primary results.

checkpoint.format: explicit allowlisted JSON plus float64 NPZ allow_pickle=false; no pickle
checkpoint.untrusted: validate chain and blobs; checkpoint hash is a journal commitment; external anchor required before production fast restore

integrity.real_volume_probe: NOT RUN; separate infrastructure authorization required

statistical.primary: TURN22 Q75,12H,three patterns and mirrors,six contrasts
statistical.planning_rule: sigma=max(0.04,2*largest development inclusive-regime residual SD across LONG/SHORT); conditional effective-n planning, never a guaranteed future variance bound
statistical.baseline: all eligible hours including events/neighbors; same side/month/closed4H regime/causal volatility tercile
statistical.bootstrap: resample complete calendar7day blocks jointly for hourly outcomes, all event labels and baseline; recompute cell means in each replicate
statistical.untestable: p=1 in Holm family; no promotion of exploratory cases; no outcome-driven extension
